The Light Blue Cambell Chambray Utility offers the same structured softness as the classic Cambell — easy to wear seven days a week — with one defining addition: a double button-through chest pocket that gives it a distinctly utilitarian, casual character. The twill chambray delivers just enough texture to feel relaxed, while still reading incredibly presentable.
Whether you're layering it under a jacket or wearing it on its own, the Cambell Utility moves effortlessly from weekend errands to a casual Friday at the office. The Hidden Button-Down collar keeps the look clean and unfussy, while White Rim buttons — reinforced with tension threading — ensure lasting quality.
Style Note: We recommend the Contemporary or Classic fit for a more relaxed, casual look.
Each Cambell Utility is made to order and available in Ledbury's four signature fits — Extra Slim, Tailored, Contemporary, and Classic — with customizable sleeve length, body length, and collar options.
Details:
• Fabric: 100% Cotton
• Buttons: White Rim, reinforced with tension threading
• Collar, Unless Customized: Hidden Button-Down
• Cuff: Double button barrel cuff
